review_scope: Independent final review of finalzero firmware source, dual Keil images, fixture, and host/runner default manifest paths and angle decoding.
manifest_binding: Both hosts use the finalzero default. The manifest is generated downstream using these independent source/build hashes.
findings: The mode-1 final tray release uses the existing 100 ms PWM-success dwell. Phase 31 submits a DM-only logical 0 degree request. Only a matching IT3 DONE advances to phase 32, which timestamps completion and publishes state 6.
The existing IT3/SPF owner retains the referenced lift and extension admission, fresh settled DM feedback, and fault/STOP/timeout handling. Mode 0 and mode 2 paths are unchanged.
The cycle runner observes final logical feedback as an IEEE-754 float and watches state 6 before reporting recovery completion.
